import { Component, OnInit, ChangeDetectorRef } from '@angular/core'; import { RegisterService, RegisterRequest, RegisterResponse, UsernameCheckResponse, PasswordValidationRequest, PasswordValidationResponse, EmailValidationRequest, EmailValidationResponse } from './register.service'; interface Task { description: string; roleName: string; selected: boolean; } @Component({ selector: 'app-register', templateUrl: './register.component.html', styleUrls: ['./register.component.css'] }) export class RegisterComponent implements OnInit { ime: string = ''; username: string = ''; email: string = ''; password: string = ''; confirmPassword: string = ''; tasks: Task[] = [ { description: 'Manage portfolios and transactions', roleName: 'Инвеститор', selected: false }, { description: 'Analyze data trends', roleName: 'Аналитичар', selected: false }, { description: 'Filter and compare current and historic data trends', roleName: 'Аналитичар', selected: false }, { description: 'View current and historic data trends', roleName: 'Обичен корисник', selected: false }, { description: 'Do basic filtering and limited searching', roleName: 'Обичен корисник', selected: false } ]; ulogaNames: string[] = []; response: RegisterResponse | null = null; generalError: string | null = null; usernameError: string | null = null; emailError: string | null = null; passwordError: string | null = null; confirmPasswordError: string | null = null; isUsernameValid: boolean = true; isEmailValid: boolean = true; isPasswordValid: boolean = true; constructor( private registerService: RegisterService, private cdr: ChangeDetectorRef ) { } ngOnInit(): void { // Force change detection to ensure button is disabled on load this.cdr.detectChanges(); } validateUsername(): void { if (this.username.trim() === '') { this.usernameError = null; this.isUsernameValid = false; return; } this.registerService.checkUsername(this.username).subscribe({ next: (response: UsernameCheckResponse) => { this.isUsernameValid = !response.exists; this.usernameError = response.exists ? 'Username already exists' : null; }, error: (err: any) => { console.error('Username check failed:', err); this.isUsernameValid = true; // Assume valid if check fails this.usernameError = null; } }); } validateEmail(): void { if (this.email.trim() === '') { this.emailError = null; this.isEmailValid = false; return; } this.registerService.validateEmail({ email: this.email }).subscribe({ next: (response: EmailValidationResponse) => { this.isEmailValid = response.isValid; this.emailError = response.isValid ? null : response.message; }, error: (err: any) => { console.error('Email validation failed:', err); this.isEmailValid = true; // Assume valid if check fails this.emailError = null; } }); } validatePassword(): void { if (this.password.trim() === '' || this.confirmPassword.trim() === '') { this.passwordError = null; this.confirmPasswordError = null; this.isPasswordValid = false; return; } this.registerService.validatePassword({ password: this.password, confirmPassword: this.confirmPassword }).subscribe({ next: (response: PasswordValidationResponse) => { this.isPasswordValid = response.isValid; if (!response.isValid) { if (response.message.includes('do not match')) { this.passwordError = null; this.confirmPasswordError = response.message; } else { this.passwordError = response.message; this.confirmPasswordError = null; } } else { this.passwordError = null; this.confirmPasswordError = null; } }, error: (err: any) => { console.error('Password validation failed:', err); this.isPasswordValid = true; // Assume valid if check fails this.passwordError = null; this.confirmPasswordError = null; } }); } updateUlogaNames(): void { const selectedRoles = this.tasks.filter(task => task.selected).map(task => task.roleName); this.ulogaNames = [...new Set(selectedRoles)]; // Unique role names } isFormValid(): boolean { return this.ime.trim() !== '' && this.username.trim() !== '' && this.email.trim() !== '' && this.password.trim() !== '' && this.confirmPassword.trim() !== '' && this.ulogaNames.length > 0; } register(): void { if (!this.isFormValid()) { this.generalError = 'Please fill all fields correctly and select at least one task.'; return; } const request: RegisterRequest = { ime: this.ime, username: this.username, email: this.email, password: this.password, confirmPassword: this.confirmPassword, ulogaNames: this.ulogaNames }; this.registerService.register(request).subscribe({ next: (response: RegisterResponse) => { this.response = response; this.generalError = null; // Reset form this.resetForm(); }, error: (err: any) => { this.response = null; this.generalError = err.error?.message || 'Registration failed'; } }); } resetForm(): void { this.ime = ''; this.username = ''; this.email = ''; this.password = ''; this.confirmPassword = ''; this.tasks.forEach(task => task.selected = false); this.ulogaNames = []; this.usernameError = null; this.emailError = null; this.passwordError = null; this.confirmPasswordError = null; this.isUsernameValid = true; this.isEmailValid = true; this.isPasswordValid = true; } clearSuccessMessage(): void { this.response = null; this.resetForm(); } }
